# NFQWS2 stock init fixture

`S51nfqws2` is an unmodified, read-only installed-router snapshot of the
`nfqws2-keenetic` 1.3.1 package, captured on 2026-10-22. Its package control
record identifies the source as [nfqws/nfqws2-keenetic](https://github.com/nfqws/nfqws2-keenetic)
and the license as MIT. The fixture is read as data and is never executed.
